data.name: Natalina
data.gender_notes: Natalina is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from Natale, meaning ‘born’, and the diminutive suffix -ina, meaning ‘little girl’. In Christian tradition, the name Natalina is associated with the Nativity of Christ and the celebration of new life. The name Natalina carries the meaning “Reborn, Little Girl” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Natalina usually hope their child will grow to embody reborn, little girl and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of rebirth and renewal, carrying the hope and promise of a new beginning.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Natalina total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_hebrew.name: נטלינה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew word natal (נטל), meaning given, born, or taken. The feminine form natalit (נטלית) means given, born, or taken, and the suffix -ina is a diminutive or pet form.

in_greek.name: Ναταλίνα
in_greek.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word natalína (ναταλίνα), meaning given, born, or taken. The name is a combination of the words natal (ναταλ), meaning birth, and the diminutive suffix -ina.

in_latin.name: Natalina
in_latin.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word natalis (nātalīs), meaning relating to birth. The name Natalina is a feminine form of the masculine name Natalis, meaning born on the Nativity of Christ day.

in_english.name: Natalina
in_english.long_meaning: Derived from the English words natal (relating to birth) and the diminutive suffix -ina.
